name: sdd-kit
description: The tools for MediaInterface's Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflow: /create-decision and /create-lesson-learned capture decisions and lessons in the Memory Bank, /spec-pr opens a PR for an approved spec instead of writing an implementation plan (applied automatically in repos on ado.mediainterface.de via a SessionStart hook), and /ado-pr, /ado-workitem and /ado-pipeline handle Azure DevOps via the az CLI.
